summary: Iteration 4 (Omni-Mining orchestrator) backend testing complete. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4_mining.py with 22 tests covering all 7 mining endpoints + heartbeat hashrate/algo persistence + tier multiplier math + admin RBAC + cross-user isolation. All 22 iter-4 tests PASS. Full regression of iter 1/2/3 also re-run: 67 passed, 1 skipped (unchanged from previous baseline). Total backend coverage: 89/89 passing tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1235 lines — getting close to the 700-line guideline ceiling and should be split into modules (auth/, devices/, jobs/, mining/, admin/) before next iteration.
MINING_PROFILES.symbol_per_hps_day values are hard-coded approximations; if/when real Binance pool integration replaces the simulation, these constants should move to live oracle data.
/api/admin/mining/stats devices payload returns up to 200 active devices but the active list is fetched with .to_list(1000) — consider a single bounded fetch or pagination params for large fleets.

/api/admin/mining/revenue calls admin_mining_stats(user) directly via Python (fine), but it re-runs the whole aggregation; cache the stats result for a short TTL or share with stats endpoint to reduce DB pressure.

Heartbeat allows arbitrary client-reported `hashrate` to be persisted unsanitised — it directly drives revenue math. Add server-side sanity caps (e.g., clamp to <= base_hashrate * tier_mult * tolerance) before stats reads it; otherwise a malicious worker can inflate aggregate hashrate and reported revenue.
test_credentials: admin@thegrid.io / Grid@Admin2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Fresh worker accounts are auto-created with UUID emails per test for isolation.
seed_data_creation: Each test class registers fresh worker accounts (miner_*, tier_*, hb_*, stats_*, snoop_*, propagate-* devices). No persistent seed mutations. Active mining coin is restored to BTC at session teardown via autouse fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-4 mining suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4_mining.py. EXPECTED_PROFILES dict mirrors server MINING_PROFILES — keep in sync if base_hashrate or stratum URLs ever change. Tier multipliers tested on BTC (base 1_000_000) for round-number assertions. Admin coin select endpoint persists to db.config{key:'mining_active'} — restored to BTC at end-of-session. If parallel pytest runs are introduced later, add per-test active-coin guards because the active coin is a global server resource.
